shill: Add mockable keyword In general, the virtual keyword is used for methods that are going to be mocked, even if those methods should not be inherited by non-mock children. This works fine for projects that have a flat or very simple inheritance hierarchy. Shill, however, has neither of those, and the most complex inheritance hierarchies (e.g. the Service and Device hierarchies) become much more difficult to read and understand when one is never sure if a virtual method is used just for mocks or is also overridden by children.
